segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to merge with or acquire an operating business; has generated no revenues to date.
segments.evidence: The CODM assesses performance for the single segment and decides how to allocate resources based on net income that also is reported on the statements of operations as net income.

revenueModel.text: No customers pay the company; it generates no revenues until it completes an initial business combination.
revenueModel.evidence: We have generated no revenues to date and we do not expect that we will generate operating revenues until we consummate our initial business combination, at the earliest.
